structured.answer: After 8 years, putting in 500 ₪ a month, I'd have about 68,853 ₪ in hand (I put in 48,000). For 4 years the calculator gave me no number: for self-employed it says "עוד אין כאן חישוב למשיכה לפני 6 שנים", only that I'd pay tax.

stuck.where: Calculator after choosing 4 years as עצמאים
stuck.why: No result for me, just an orange note. The only number left was 25,725 next to an empty dashed box labelled 'אותו כסף בחשבון ניירות...', and I wasn't sure if that was my fund or something else
The fields moved around: 'תשואה בשנה' jumped to the left and 'דמי ניהול' dropped down a row, so I had to look again
